result.question: What was Tesla's gross profit in fiscal year 2024?
result.answer: Tesla's gross profit in fiscal year 2024 was $17,450 million ($17.45 billion), as reported in its Consolidated Statements of Operations [0001628280-25-003063:item-8-p005]. This figure is confirmed by the XBRL-reported Gross Profit of 17,450,000,000 USD for the period ending December 31, 2024 [xbrl:0001628280-26-003952:us-gaap:GrossProfit:2024-12-31]. By way of context, this represented a slight decline from $17,660 million in fiscal year 2023 [0001628280-25-003063:item-8-p005]. The total gross profit can also be reconciled to the two reportable segments: automotive gross profit of $14,810 million and energy generation and storage gross profit of $2,640 million, which together sum to $17,450 million [0001628280-25-003063:item-8-p060].
